answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37842 Country: India Title: About nafi Name Question: Nafi is my son name. I found the name in 99 Names of ALLAH. So please can i know a its meaning? Is it ok for baby boy name in Islam? Answer ID: 37842 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 566/477/B=1433) Nafi’ (نافع) means one who gives benefit. It is not good to name only ‘Nafi’ as it is one of the Names of Allah. But, if add ‘Abdul’ before it and name as ‘Abdu-al-Nafi’, then it will be alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
